clauses.rationale: Standalone representations do not become Definition artifacts by themselves. Rich artifacts containing quotations or ontology links are not excluded.
Independent classification axes require model-pair/non-entailment contracts and canonical value/coupling semantics. Different nominal sorts alone do not prove independence.
No-inference between canonical fields is a policy/evidence obligation; no arbitrary negated implication is assumed in T.
A declared axis dependence must have an explicit typed axis relation. Actual admitted Relation Kind/endpoint/qualifier/owner validity is not established by this primitive predicate.
Convenience labels are generated projections; generation does not imply normative authority.

Schema validity/evidence do not perform promotion: retain causal/process aspect and separate non-entailment witness queries; do not assert that valid/evidenced artifacts can never be admitted.

Non-entailment is a metalevel countermodel requirement, not an axiom denying admission to every complete record. Separate query descriptor requests Complete and not Admitted outside T.
